annotations.title: Get a link to post a job request

description: Returns a TexContractor link where the homeowner posts their job (description, city, photos) so nearby pros contact them. Set urgent=true for BOOM: the job is sent straight to pros near them right away and stays open 24 hours. The homeowner signs in with their phone; nothing is posted until they confirm.

urgent.description: true if they need help today
